description: Data payload shape of 'policy.get' and 'policy.set' (envelope.data). policy.get reports the SQLite layer, effective values and attribution; policy.set reports the SQLite write. Builtin defaults supply effective values before the database exists; the local request argument is not a second storage layer.

layers.description: SQLite policy content for policy.get, or null for policy.set.

sqlite.description: Persisted policy content from native-manager.db, or null when the database has no policy entry.

effective.description: Effective result of builtin defaults plus SQLite policy for policy.get, or null for policy.set. Free-form object.

attribution.description: Top-level key -> defining source ('builtin'|'sqlite') for policy.get; null for policy.set. Free-form object.

layer.description: Persisted source returned by policy.set ('sqlite'), or null for policy.get. The request still uses '--layer local'.

key.description: Dot-path written by policy.set, or null for policy.get.

value.description: Value written by policy.set (any JSON), or null for policy.get. Untyped by design: the policy tree is free-form below top level.

path.description: SQLite database destination written by policy.set, or null for policy.get.
